2020: 5/19 Dominic Cimilluca on runoff from Ski Hill Rd; record May rain flooded Spring Creek homes outside the village; 6/2 Nunamaker to work with the county, McLaughlin backed removing floodway structures; 7/7 Elder Ln and Paul Ct residents blamed two pipes under Algonquin Rd for Shannon Creek erosion, told to contact McHenry County Stormwater; 11/10 Doyle Rd stormwater project up to $165,000; 12/15 county stormwater ordinance adopted 6-0. 2021: 1/19 village became a certified stormwater community.
Whether Shannon Creek work was ever done.
Picnic Grove bike path
Path linking Spring St and Ski Hill Rd to Picnic Grove Park.
2020: 6/2 $140,000 state grant via Sen. McConchie, Segments 1 and 3 chosen, OSLAD to be sought; 10/20 Res 2020-12 ITEP 20% local match 6-0; 11/10 Baxter & Woodman design 4-0.
Construction timing (see Sidewalk program).
Park land encroachments
Neighbors who built driveways, walls or sheds on village park land.

2019: 8/15 sold a small piece of Picnic Grove Park on Pleasant St to the neighbor for a driveway 6-0. 2020: 1/21 Res 2020-01 sold a sliver of Village Park No. 2 with a neighbor's slab and parking 5-0; 9/15 board wanted land back at North River Road Park #3 (wall, shed, driveway 7-8 ft over); 10/20 Paul Rozek (416 N River Rd) said a former president promised first refusal and asked to keep it, board to consider a sale.
Outcome at North River Road Park #3.
Culver's redevelopment (2019)
New Culver's built with TIF assistance under a redevelopment agreement with SREVLUC, LLC.
2019: 1/17 redevelopment agreement with TIF assistance passed 4-1 (Curtiss no); 6/20 Srevluc 2 license to keep parking on village right-of-way 5-0; 12/17 Culver's set to open Jan 13, 2020.
Cannabis rules
How the village handled legal recreational cannabis (sales, zoning, possession).

2019: 8/15 Mick Gasso opposed sales; 12/3 dispensary zoning (special use) 4-1 (Schladt no); 12/17 Kathy Boruch backed sales for the revenue; possession ordinance (local ticket option) 3-2 plus President (Fleischmann, Schladt no). 2025: 6/3 business use table rewrite made dispensaries a permitted use.
Whether a dispensary ever applies.
418 Concord (Strohl tours)
Special use for tours and events at the Strohl home, 416-418 Concord Ave.

2019: 6/20 Michael Strohl asked to expand his tours permit; 10/15 Ord 2019-19 special use passed 4-2 (Curtiss, Schladt no), Halloween event limited to the weekend before Halloween; neighbor Karen Wrobbel worried the home was becoming a business. 2025: 4/22 special uses rescinded 6-0 after neighbor complaints.
Board changes (2019)
Turnover on the board during 2019.

2019: 2/7 Melissa Schladt sworn in; 4/18 Steve Knar's last meeting (he returned in 2021); Thomas Anderson joined in May and resigned effective 12/1; 12/3 Marc McLaughlin appointed 4-0 to Anderson's seat.
Village debt payoff (2019)
The village retired its last bond debt.

2019: 2/25 Road Bond and Public Works Facility Bond set to be paid off in December using MFT, General Capital and Water/Sewer Capital; 4/18 budget confirmed it; 12/3 Soderholm said the village is debt free.
Centennial (2019)
Fox River Grove's 100th anniversary year.

2019: Centennial Carnival (fee waivers 3/21), parade and Musicfest in summer; 9/17 County Board Chairman Jack Franks gave the village an award; 11/5 Algonquin Township proclamation; final event New Year's Eve at Avante.
